git add -A && git commit -m "Refactor: Add Level 8 features - API Contracts, Rate Limiting, Tracing, Audit Log

Production API Layer:

API Request/Response Contracts:
- GraphRequest: Encapsulates all request parameters with unique ID
  - Operation type, parameters map, client ID
  - Timestamp for tracking
  - Standard request format
  
- GraphResponse<T>: Type-safe response container
  - Status codes (200, 201, 400, 404, 500, 503)
  - Processing time tracking
  - Trace ID for distributed tracing
  - Generic data payload
  - Success indicator methods

Rate Limiting:
- RateLimiter: Token bucket algorithm
  - Configurable max requests per time window
  - Per-client tracking
  - Remaining request counter
  - Time window sliding
  - Reset capability

Distributed Tracing:
- DistributedTracer: Hierarchical trace spans
  - Unique trace IDs for request correlation
  - Nested span support
  - Event recording within spans
  - ThreadLocal context preservation
  - Duration tracking (nanosecond precision)
  - Singleton pattern for cross-layer access

Audit Logging:
- AuditLog: Immutable audit trail
  - Client ID, operation type, resource, action tracking
  - Success/failure recording
  - Timestamp capture
  - Synchronized list for thread safety
  - Max size limit (10000 entries)
  - Audit trail retrieval per client
  - Chronological ordering

Service Statistics:
- ServiceStatistics: Comprehensive metrics aggregation
  - Total request counting
  - Success/failure tracking
  - Success rate calculation
  - Processing time averaging
  - Per-operation metrics
  - Thread-safe atomic operations
  - Statistics reset capability

API Gateway:
- APIGateway: Request middleware pipeline
  - Rate limit enforcement
  - Request validation
  - Trace ID propagation
  - Audit logging integration
  - Exception handling
  - Status code generation
  - Processing time tracking
  - Handler pattern for operation execution

Integration Flow:
1. Request arrives at gateway
2. Rate limiting check (per client)
3. Request validation
4. Trace span creation
5. Handler execution
6. Response creation with trace ID
7. Audit log entry
8. Statistics recording
9. Span completion

Advanced Features:
- ThreadLocal for trace context
- Synchronized collections for thread safety
- Atomic operations for counters
- ConcurrentHashMap for client buckets
- Generic response for type safety
- Standard HTTP status codes

Observability:
- Every request has unique ID
- Distributed tracing via trace IDs
- Complete audit trail per client
- Success rates and performance metrics
- Span-level event tracking
- Processing time breakdown

Compliance:
- Audit trail immutable
- Rate limiting prevents abuse
- Request validation ensures safety
- Exception handling prevents data leak
- Trace IDs enable debugging

Files Added:
- GraphRequest.java (API request contract)
- GraphResponse.java (API response contract)
- RateLimiter.java (token bucket rate limiting)
- DistributedTracer.java (hierarchical tracing)
- AuditLog.java (immutable audit trail)
- ServiceStatistics.java (metrics aggregation)
- APIGateway.java (request middleware)

Co-Authored-By: Claude Haiku 4.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>"
